snippet.title: Kimodameshi Online - Teaser Trailer | 4-8 Player Online Horror Streaming Game (Steam, Oct 2026)
snippet.description:
Go live from a haunted school at night.
The scarier it gets, the more viewers you get. But one of your friends is possessed.

▼ Official website
https://kimodameshi-online.com/en/

▼ Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5321510/_/

▼ Official Discord
https://discord.gg/gFvdH4ZgV7

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

■ Everyone's a streamer. 4–8 friends, one school at night.
An online test of courage you play over voice chat, set in a Showa-era junior high school frozen since the day of an accident.

■ The scarier it gets, the more viewers you get.
Film the paranormal and carry it out of the school. Scream, run, make it a show — the hotter the stream, the more your channel grows.

■ One of your friends is possessed.
One to three traitors walk beside you like nothing's wrong — then slip through walls, set traps and wreck the stream.

■ Only those nearby can hear you.
Voices go muffled behind walls and barely carry between floors. Get separated, and your friends go silent.

■ Never the same school twice.
A Showa-era junior high whose rooms are rearranged every round.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

■ Game info
Title: Kimodameshi Online
Genre: Asymmetric online horror (test of courage)
Players: 4–8 (online)
Platform: Windows (Steam)
Release: OUT NOW!
Languages: Japanese, English, German, French, Italian, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese

■ Streams and clips: all welcome.
Individuals and companies may stream, upload and monetize — no permission needed.
Free thumbnail assets and a thumbnail maker are available on the official website.
https://kimodameshi-online.com/en/maker/
Tag your posts with #肝試しONLINE so everyone can find them.

■ Developers
Development: Panda
Design: Uzumi Tsumiki

■ Music
BGM: That Epic / Merry bad ending (OpenTracks)
Sound effects: Koukaon Lab (効果音ラボ)

#肝試しONLINE #KimodameshiOnline #HorrorGame #Steam #Multiplayer
